captions.detailed: A compact, matte-black on-camera camera flash accessory. It consists of a vertical rectangular main body with filleted edges, a thin metallic shoe mount at the base, and a side-mounted battery door panel. The top of the body connects via a cylindrical swivel neck to a U-shaped cradle, which holds a rectangular bounce flash head that can tilt horizontally.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact on-camera camera flash with a narrow body, a rectangular bounce head, and a low shoe mount. The flash head should be able to swivel on a vertical axis relative to the body, tilt on a horizontal hinge inside a mounting cradle, and feature a rotatable battery door on the side of the main body.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a filleted Box primitive, then attach a thin metal-colored Box at the bottom as the shoe mount. Model the battery door as a thin Box offset on the side of the body. Create a cylindrical neck on top of the body to support a U-shaped cradle. Finally, model the rectangular flash head as a filleted Box suspended inside the cradle with cylindrical hinge connectors, defining the swivel, tilt, and door rotation joints via local origin offsets and rotational axes.
